name: Hitting Size of Warmuth's $C_5$ Class
proof: The five concepts with their unrestricted coordinate set to zero have supports $\{0,3\},\{1,4\},\{0,2\},\{1,3\},\{2,4\}$. These are the edges of a $5$-cycle, whose minimum vertex cover has size three, so every hitting set has size at least three. Any three-coordinate vertex cover of this cycle meets those five supports and hence also their one-coordinate extensions, giving a hitting set.
